Simple heading followed by paragraph produces Heading and Paragraph nodes

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import ConversionOptions, convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<h1>Title</h1><p>A paragraph of text.</p>"
    options = ConversionOptions(include_document_structure=True)
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)
    print((result.document.nodes if result.document else None))

main()
```
